history_summary: Add the Halobacillus halophilus species-name GTDB correspondence
history_details: The selected Halobacillus halophilus descriptor resolves by species-name fallback to two reference genomes with fraction 1.0. This population does not identify or equate the genomes of source stocks MKM4 and MKM11; their cited accessions are 16S sequences. Preserve the three-strain/two-descriptor representation, Halobacillus marinus MKM3 native-null status, all source wording and all existing host and interaction claims. Only the selected GTDB block/status and two native inline events change. Full scientific review, source-snippet coverage and corpus QC remain separate.
